Topics · One God, one message

Must I give up remembering my ancestors?

The Quran ranks duty to parents high and gives a prayer for them. Nothing here asks you to stop remembering.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَـٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا٢٣ وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا٢٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

And your Lord has decreed that you worship not except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff,"[735] and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word. And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small."

Translator's notes

[735] An expression of disapproval or irritation.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:23-24

Translation

Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

Original · Hebrew

שְׁמַ֣ע לְ֭אָבִיךָ זֶ֣ה יְלָדֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־תָּ֝ב֗וּז כִּֽי־זָקְנָ֥ה אִמֶּֽךָ׃

Proverbs · 23:22

World English Bible

Start with what you already hold. A person who was carried, fed and taught owes something that cannot be repaid. Children feel it long before they have a word for it. This passage opens by keeping worship for God alone, then puts it in the strongest terms: kindness to parents, patience when they grow old, a gentle word, humility toward them out of mercy. Remembering them is not a leftover custom. It is gratitude that has outlived the person it was for.

A question for you

What does remembering your parents give you?

If you sayA place where I belong.
ThenThen remembering is more than duty. It is how you stay part of a line. The next passage is about that line.
If you sayPeace that I did what a child does.
ThenThat peace is real, and it is the kind the passage describes: gratitude that reaches backwards.
If you sayI am not sure. I just do it.
ThenThat is how most of what matters gets done. The next passage gives a reason it matters even when no reason is spoken.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَـٰلُهُۥ فِى عَامَيْنِ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.

Quran · Luqman 31:14

Translation

Honor your father with your whole heart, and don’t forget the birth pangs of your mother.

Original · Ancient Greek

Ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ δόξασον τὸν πατέρα σου, καὶ μητρὸς ὠδῖνας μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ.

Sirach · 7:27

World English Bible

﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes[1038] and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."

Translator's notes

[1038] i.e., a source of happiness due to their righteousness.

Quran · Al-Furqan 25:74

Translation

Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good. In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another, not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord, rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer, contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

Original · Ancient Greek

Ἡ ἀγάπη ἀνυπόκριτος. ἀποστυγοῦντες τὸ πονηρόν, κολλώμενοι τῷ ἀγαθῷ· τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ εἰς ἀλλήλους φιλόστοργοι, τῇ τιμῇ ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι, τῇ σπουδῇ μὴ ὀκνηροί, τῷ πνεύματι ζέοντες, τῷ κυρίῳ δουλεύοντες, τῇ ἐλπίδι χαίροντες, τῇ θλίψει ὑπομένοντες, τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτεροῦντες, ταῖς χρείαις τῶν ἁγίων κοινωνοῦντες, τὴν φιλοξενίαν διώκοντες.

Romans · 12:9-13

World English Bible

The first passage adds the mother's labour: weakness upon weakness, the long months, the years of feeding. Thanks here is not only a feeling. It is something a person says, and it runs two ways. In the second passage people ask for comfort in their own spouses and children. So care flows back to those who raised us and forward to those we are raising.

A question for you

Who carries the memory in your family?

If you sayA grandmother or an elder.
ThenThen you are holding something you can hand on, in your own words, to the next person.
If you sayI do, mostly alone.
ThenWhat you carry has worth, even when nobody shares it with you.
If you sayNobody, really.
ThenThen starting is a small thing, and it can begin with one conversation.

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:186

Translation

Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

Original · Hebrew

קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃

the Psalms · 145:18

World English Bible

Remembering has a direction. When someone speaks to a parent who has died, the words go somewhere or they go nowhere. This passage speaks of the One who is near and answers the one who calls. It makes no claim about any custom. It says that a call from the heart does not go unheard. So the mercy a child asks for a parent has an address.

A question for you

When you speak to the people you have lost, who do you imagine is listening?

If you sayThey are, I hope.
ThenHope is where most people begin. The passage adds that Someone nearer than hope hears the call itself.
If you sayNo one, but it helps.
ThenThat comfort is real. The passage says it is not only in you: there is One who hears.
If you sayI have never thought about it.
ThenThen it is a good question to leave open and come back to.

The same in the other books

Translation

‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

Original · Hebrew

קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וְאֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ וְאַגִּ֧ידָה לְּךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּבְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃

Jeremiah · 33:3

World English Bible

Translation

Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

the Psalms · 50:15

the Gospel (Matthew) · 7:7-8

World English Bible
